project_id.description: Must equal the project path parameter.

estimate_id.description: New document identity for each appended estimate; no imposed ID format.

task_id.description: Must identify a current task in this project.

task_revision.description: Must equal the current authoritative task revision.

estimate_version.description: Exactly one plus the retained maximum for this task_id and task_revision; first version is 1.

duration_hours.description: Optional reviewed elapsed duration in hours, independent of effort. Omission and null both mean unknown.

revision.description: Required DTO field. The server replaces it with document revision 1 when creating a new estimate.

title: TaskEstimate
description: POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/task-estimates body and persisted record. Owner-authenticated append-only authority command requiring Idempotency-Key. Unknown fields are rejected. Database history, current-task binding and cross-field effort ordering are validated by the server.

EffortEstimate.description: Reviewed work effort in hours. The server also checks optimistic_hours <= likely_hours <= pessimistic_hours; JSON Schema does not express this cross-field ordering. Effort is not elapsed calendar duration.
